objective: Harden ForgeLoop so product-detail questions require prior BLOCKING classification while reversible local ambiguity becomes a recorded assumption and continues to contract creation.

assumptions.value: Use a deterministic flag-based decision helper only as validation and serialization support; do not parse natural language or invoke a model.
assumptions.reason: The requested correction must strengthen one agent's behavior without adding an orchestration runtime or LLM dependency.
assumptions.scope: ForgeLoop policy validation and regression tests

deliverables: Add mandatory classify-before-ask policy and reversible positioning examples
Persist contracts before blocking clarification and preserve preflight blocking
Add deterministic decision-classification and question-justification regressions
Update shipped adapters, scorecard, and single-agent conformance metadata
constraints: Preserve protocol version 1, assumptions schema, lifecycle, forgeloop next, evidence, and false-completion semantics
Do not hardcode a law-firm positioning choice or present agent assumptions as user or business facts
Do not install unrelated software, publish, deploy, or change external systems
Execute all analysis, planning, implementation, tests, review, and release preparation inline with one primary agent and no subagents or delegation
risks: Reversible product ambiguity causing a clarification stop before contract creation
Blocking decisions being asked without persisted unresolvedDecisions[] or a reason code
Regression in contract, preflight, lifecycle, evidence, or package boundaries
stopConditions: A required local check remains blocked after diagnosis
A proposed change would alter frozen lifecycle, evidence, schema, or false-completion behavior
An external publication decision is required
